name: How long does it take to install a bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a new bathroom vanity usually takes between 2 to 4 hours for a direct, same-size swap. If your project involves moving plumbing lines, replacing drywall, or installing a new tile backsplash behind the cabinet, the job can extend to a full day or across two days. When replacing an existing vanity, the old unit must be disconnected and removed, the wall inspected for hidden moisture damage, and the subfloor checked. If new flooring or wall repairs are needed before setting the cabinet, that finish work must dry before final plumbing connections are secured.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard vanity swap takes about 2 to 4 hours. If plumbing needs to move or wall repairs and custom tile work are required, installation can take one to two days.
